summary: DiaGyn Staff Portal testing complete. Fixed critical bug where Emergency booking failed due to Pydantic model requiring 'time' field. All features verified: staff login, clinic toggle (Pushpa/Amnion), Walk-in tab with session logic (No Active Session at ~3am IST), Emergency 24x7 booking, Book Appointment tab with slot filtering, appointment status workflow (Booked→CheckedIn→WithDoctor→Completed), fee code selection, and collection summaries.

bugs_fixed.issue: Emergency booking failed with Pydantic validation error - 'time' field was required but Emergency bookings send null
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed 'time: str' to 'time: Optional[str] = None' in AppointmentBook model (line 283)
